name: High-Resolution ROI Detection Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for 2D object, ROI, chart-component, medical finding, document, industrial defect, wildlife face, and small-target detection competitions that combine high-resolution training at 640px, 1024px, 1280x1280, or tiled crops; ImageNet-pretrained ResNet, ResNeSt, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, Swin, or HRNet-W32 backbones; Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, Cascade R-CNN, RetinaNet, YOLO, DETR, or segmentation-detector hybrids; multi-scale feature extraction; ROI cropping or component detection; optional attribute-aware classification heads; class-imbalance handling; NMS, Soft-NMS, weighted box fusion, PointRend boundary refinement, or mask/box post-processing; and metric-specific threshold calibration.
dejargonized_summary: Keep enough image resolution to see small regions, train one or more object detectors or segmentation-assisted ROI models, crop or refine likely regions, merge overlapping boxes or masks, and tune thresholds for the benchmark metric.

inputs.name: high_resolution_images
inputs.constraints: Images, boxes, masks, keypoints, component labels, study IDs, or metadata for 2D detection or ROI localization.

outputs.name: roi_detections
outputs.constraints: Boxes, masks, component labels, coordinates, or detection scores formatted for the benchmark metric.

use_when: The solution must localize objects, chart elements, defects, text regions, medical findings, faces, or other regions of interest in 2D images.

Winning techniques include Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, Cascade R-CNN, RetinaNet, YOLO, DETR, ImageNet-pretrained detection backbones, HRNet-W32, high-resolution 640px+ or 1280x1280 training, tiled inference, ROI cropping, multi-scale feature extraction, attribute-aware classification heads, PointRend boundary refinement, weighted box fusion, Soft-NMS, or threshold calibration.
Small objects, high-resolution source images, overlapping detections, or component-level structure are load-bearing for the metric.
do_not_use_when: The task is primarily image classification with no spatial output.
The output is a retrieval list or nearest-neighbor match rather than boxes, masks, coordinates, or ROI-level predictions.
The task is 3D volumetric medical segmentation where voxel geometry and 3D ROI crops dominate.
applicability.key_insight: The durable topology is resolution-preserving preprocessing before detector or segmentation-assisted ROI localization, followed by overlap-aware post-processing and metric calibration. This differs from fine-grained classification because spatial localization is the primary artifact.

swappable_stages.detector_backbone_ensemble: Can use Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, Cascade R-CNN, RetinaNet, YOLO, DETR, Detectron2, MMDetection, or segmentation-assisted detectors with ImageNet-pretrained CNN/Transformer backbones such as HRNet-W32.
swappable_stages.roi_refinement: Can use tiled crops, multi-scale feature pyramids, ROIAlign, component graph cleanup, mask-to-box conversion, keypoint heads, attribute-aware classification heads, PointRend boundary refinement, or a second-stage classifier over detected regions.
swappable_stages.overlap_postprocessing: Can use NMS, Soft-NMS, weighted box fusion, mask voting, connected components, or class-specific score thresholds.

applicability.scaling_notes: Cache resized tiles or crops, keep box transforms invertible back to source coordinates, and validate resolution, crop, and threshold choices on held-out folds.
failure_modes: Downsampling can erase small targets before the detector sees them.
Tiling without overlap can cut objects at crop boundaries.
Aggressive NMS can suppress true adjacent objects, while weak NMS can duplicate detections.

planning_constraints.subject: preserve_coordinates_through_tiling
planning_constraints.statement: Track tile, crop, scale, and padding transforms so detections can be mapped back to source-image coordinates.
planning_constraints.rationale: Detection submissions are invalid if ROI coordinates are calibrated in crop space instead of original-image space.

audit.rationale: Added in the final broad enrichment pass after repeated support-2 gaps shared high-resolution training, Faster R-CNN/ROI detection, ImageNet-pretrained backbones, multi-scale feature extraction, and overlap-aware detection post-processing across chart, medical, document, wildlife, and industrial image tasks.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This covers spatial detection tasks where preserving image resolution and merging detector outputs are the reusable structure.
uncertainty_notes: Domain-specific label ontologies, chart parsers, and medical-windowing choices should stay as refinements unless they change the detection topology.

references.title: Sciona 141-CDG final tail gap audit
references.note: Deterministic and semantic audit of remaining support-2 ROI/object detection gaps.

stages.name: Resolution-Preserving Preprocessing
stages.description: Decode source images, preserve coordinate metadata, resize or tile at high resolution such as 640px, 1024px, or 1280x1280, normalize channels, and apply box-safe augmentations.
stages.dejargonized_description: Prepare images without losing small objects or breaking box coordinates.

outputs.name: detector_inputs
outputs.constraints: High-resolution images or tiles with transformed annotations.

preconditions: Images and spatial annotations are available.
guarantees: Coordinate transforms are invertible back to source images.

stages.name: Detector Backbone Ensemble
stages.description: Train Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, Cascade R-CNN, RetinaNet, YOLO, DETR, or segmentation-assisted detectors with ImageNet-pretrained ResNet, ResNeSt, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, Swin, HRNet-W32, or feature-pyramid backbones.
stages.dejargonized_description: Train one or more detectors to find the target regions.

outputs.name: raw_detections
outputs.constraints: Boxes, masks, classes, and confidence scores.

preconditions: Detector architecture and validation folds are selected.
guarantees: Candidate regions are produced with scores.

stages.name: ROI Refinement
stages.description: Refine detections with ROIAlign, crop-level classifiers, component grouping, mask-to-box conversion, multi-scale feature extraction, keypoint heads, attribute-aware classification heads, PointRend boundary refinement, or second-stage region scoring.
stages.dejargonized_description: Clean up likely regions and rescore them with focused context.

outputs.name: refined_detections
outputs.constraints: Refined boxes, masks, classes, and scores.

stages.name: Overlap Postprocessing
stages.description: Apply NMS, Soft-NMS, weighted box fusion, mask voting, connected components, duplicate removal, and coordinate remapping from tiles to source images.
stages.dejargonized_description: Merge duplicate detections and put coordinates back in the original image.
preconditions: Overlap policy and coordinate transforms are known.
guarantees: Duplicate detections are reduced without losing source coordinates.

stages.name: Detection Metric Calibration
stages.description: Tune class-specific thresholds, box or mask score cutoffs, per-image limits, precision-recall operating points, and output formatting for the benchmark metric.
stages.dejargonized_description: Convert merged detector outputs into final predictions for the scoring rule.
preconditions: Metric and output schema are known.
